shortDescription: Create and manage releases in the Errata Tool

options.name: active
options.description: Is the release active for Errata filing? This field is a legacy field and it should always be "true". See CLOUDWF-4516 for more explanation about this field.

options.name: allow_blocker
options.description: Only relevant for QuarterlyUpdate releases.

options.name: allow_exception
options.description: Only relevant for QuarterlyUpdate releases.

options.name: allow_pkg_dupes
options.description: Allow duplicate advisories for packages. Only relevant for QuarterlyUpdate releases.

options.name: allow_shadow
options.description: Only relevant for QuarterlyUpdate releases.

options.name: blocker_flags
options.description: Bugzilla blocker flags (specify a list). Example: [ceph-3.0, devel_ack, qa_ack, pm_ack] If the release is a Zstream (or QuarterlyUpdate with supports_component_acl), you must specify at least one flag here. If the release is an Async, blocker_flags is not required.

options.name: brew_tags
options.description: Set to an empty list "[]" to simply inherit the brew_tags configuration from this release's ... Product Versions?.

options.name: description
options.description: example: Red Hat Ceph Storage 4.0

options.name: enable_batching
options.description: Can you group advisories in batches for this release?

options.name: enabled
options.description: Is the release enabled?

options.name: internal_target_release
options.description: Internal release target Bugzilla field Set to "null" if this release does not use this field in Bugzilla.

options.name: is_silent
options.description: Skip customer notifications for any advisories shipped in the release Normally set to true for RHEL minor version == 0 releases, e.g. 9.0, 10.0, 11.0

options.name: limit_bugs_by_product
options.description: Only relevant for QuarterlyUpdate releases.

options.name: name
options.description: example: rhceph-4.0

options.name: product
options.description: example: RHCEPH Async releases do not require a product.

options.name: product_versions
options.description: list of ET Product Versions, eg "[RHCEPH-4.0-RHEL-8, RHEL-7-RHCEPH-4.0]"

options.name: program_manager
options.description: The program manager for this release (login_name, eg "coolprogrammanager@redhat.com") This account must already exist in the Errata Tool. You may create it with the web UI, or the errata_tool_user Ansible module, or some other method. The Errata Tool does not require a specific role for this user account.

options.name: ship_date
options.description: Default ship date for new advisories. "YYYY-MM-DD" Note that you cannot use YAML's native date type here. You must quote the date value so that YAML passes a string to Ansible. If the release is a QuarterlyUpdate release, ship_date is required. If it is a Zstream or Async, ship_date is not required.

options.name: state_machine_rule_set
options.description: Workflow Rule Set If you omit this parameter, Ansible will default to "null". For new releases, this means the release will inherit the product's ruleset. For existing releases, Ansible will not edit the server-side value if this is null. To force Ansible to change an existing release's state_machine_rule_set to "null" on the ET server, set this parameter to an empty string "". For example, if the current rule set was "unrestricted" and you wanted to alter it to "null" (to inherit from the paren

options.name: supports_component_acl
options.description: If true, every Bugzilla ticket's component must be on the Approved Component List (true) for this release. If false, ET will not consult the Bugzilla Approved Component List for this release. Only relevant for QuarterlyUpdate releases.

options.name: type
options.description: example: QuarterlyUpdate

options.name: zstream_target_release
options.description: Zstream release target Bugzilla field Set to "null" if this release does not use this field in Bugzilla.
